title: Polish compact cost cards + rollout state indicators (hover + focus)
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Summary: Finalize visual polish and interaction details for the compact cost-explorer cards and rollout-state indicators used across the Console dashboard.

Context: The Console redesign adds a compact card variant for the Cost Explorer so customers can view more lines on small screens and in multi-column layouts. We introduced a new rollout-state indicator (timeline dot + badge) that surfaces canary progress, fallback triggers, and degraded model variants. Early dev implementation shows alignment issues at small breakpoints and inconsistent hover/focus behaviors that cause accessibility concerns.

Goals:
- Align compact card typography, spacing, and token usage with Console design system and token scale.
- Define exact hover, focus, and keyboard interactions for rollout-state indicators (including tooltip copy and delay timings).
- Ensure color tokens meet 4.5:1 contrast for all text in compact cards and that badges pass 3:1 when used non-textually.
- Deliver redlines and QA checklist for front-end to implement, plus a Figma prototype with interactive hover and keyboard states.

Scope (in-scope): compact cost card (compact, compact-with-sparkline), rollout-state indicator (dot + badge + hover tooltip), responsive layout behavior between 320px and 1280px, keyboard focus ring visuals, and aria-label copy for assistive tech.

Out-of-scope: full Cost Explorer graph interactions, billing export flow, backend metric schema changes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Visual redlines in Figma exported and attached.
- Prototype demonstrates hover (200ms show, 250ms hide) and keyboard focus states.
- Accessibility checks documented and color tokens adjusted where necessary.
- Dev PR references this ticket and links to component implementation story.

Design constraints and trade-offs:
- Compact card reduces padding by one token but retains 14px body type to preserve readability for numeric values.
- Rollout dot size reduced to 8px to avoid visual noise in dense lists; badge only appears for non-ok states to reduce clutter.
- Tooltip delay chosen after developer input to balance discoverability and accidental flicker on pointer devices.

Deliverables:
- Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/console-cost-compact-cards
- Prototype link: https://www.figma.com/proto/abcdef/compact-cost-cards?node-id=...
- Redlines PDF attached to this ticket.
- QA checklist and keyboard interaction spec (see attachments).
